summary.text: Brian Ignatowski is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Jennifer Conlin. He was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brian Ignatowski ran for Michigan House of Representatives District 48 in the November 2024 general election.
Incumbent Democrat Jennifer Conlin won that election with 51.5 percent of the vote, ahead of Ignatowski with 47.1 percent and Green Party candidate Eric Borregard with 1.4 percent.
